topic: Needs versus wants: how to tell the difference before you buy.

episode.title: Needs vs. Wants: The Before-You-Buy Check

shots.narration: Two purchases, one small pile of money: what comes first?
shots.scene: Bright 3D city flat, vertical 9:16 frame, table holding loose coins, dinner vegetables, and a decorative mug; no text or logos.
shots.action: Kash holds her open hands between the vegetables and the mug.
shots.mood: Bright coral and teal accents, curious expression, playful tension.

shots.narration: Kash needs dinner ingredients, but wants a decorative mug.
shots.scene: Clean modern flat kitchen, vertical frame, empty dinner bowl beside vegetables and a glossy decorative mug; no text or logos.
shots.action: Kash reaches toward the decorative mug.
shots.mood: Warm afternoon light, delighted eyes, tempting sparkle on the mug.

shots.narration: [chuckles] Coin explains: needs cover essentials; wants are nice extras.
shots.scene: Modern flat kitchen table, vegetables beside an empty dinner bowl, decorative mug farther away; no text or logos.
shots.action: Coin points toward the dinner ingredients.
shots.mood: Friendly gold glow, clear visual focus on food, attentive Kash.

shots.narration: First ask: is this essential for my everyday life?
shots.scene: Vertical close view of the kitchen table, empty dinner bowl directly behind fresh vegetables; no text or logos.
shots.action: Kash places the vegetables beside her dinner bowl.
shots.mood: Calm blue background, thoughtful expression, practical everyday warmth.

shots.narration: Then ask: do I already have something that works?
shots.scene: Bright kitchen cupboard containing a plain intact mug, decorative mug visible on the counter below; no text or logos.
shots.action: Kash lifts the plain mug from the cupboard.
shots.mood: Soft sunshine, raised eyebrows, a small moment of recognition.

shots.narration: [surprised] Her old mug works; the new one is a want.
shots.scene: Clean kitchen counter with a decorative mug beside Kash's plain mug; no text or logos.
shots.action: Kash pours water from an unmarked pitcher into her plain mug.
shots.mood: Clear sparkling water, cheerful realization, Coin smiling nearby.

shots.narration: Wants aren't bad; knowing the difference helps you choose.
shots.scene: Modern flat table with dinner vegetables in front and decorative mug off to one side; no text or logos.
shots.action: Coin gives the decorative mug a friendly thumbs-up.
shots.mood: Reassuring smile, bright friendly colours, relaxed atmosphere.

shots.narration: Kash sets aside money for dinner before the extra mug.
shots.scene: Vertical overhead-style view of the flat table, small coin pile beside vegetables, decorative mug farther away; no text or logos.
shots.action: Kash slides the coin pile toward the dinner ingredients.
shots.mood: Warm golden lighting, satisfied expression, uncluttered visual payoff.

shots.narration: [excited] Today, sort one purchase; next, explore waiting before buying.
shots.scene: Bright flat kitchen, dinner ingredients beside their coin pile, decorative mug on a separate shelf; no text or logos.
shots.action: Kash places an unmarked sand timer beside the decorative mug.
shots.mood: Playful anticipation, warm sunset colours, encouraging smiles.

episode.endHook: Next episode: can waiting help you understand a want?
episode.description: Kash wants a decorative mug, but dinner ingredients come first. Coin shares a simple way to tell needs from wants before buying. General money education, not personal financial advice.
